title.en: Diesel 60 Concrete Pump — LZ-60 prints 50 m³/h — read beside “Belt Length”
title.zh: HBT60-13.132 在邢台同时标着柴油60和 LZ-60——柴油60不印这些格子。——对照「皮带 长度」来读

description.en: Diesel 60 Concrete Pump at /products/diesel-60-concrete-pump. LZ-60 prints 50 m³/h LZ-60 prints 5500 kg
description.zh: HBT60-13.132 在邢台同时标着柴油60和 LZ-60见 /products/diesel-60-concrete-pump。柴油60不印这些格子。柴油60印 35 m³/h。

h1.en: Belt Velocity is the heading; Diesel 60 Concrete Pump stays the subject
h1.zh: 标题是「皮带 速度」，主体仍是HBT60-13.132 在邢台同时标着柴油60和 LZ-60

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints the figures for Diesel 60 Concrete Pump. The row to open is /products/diesel-60-concrete-pump. LZ-60 prints 50 m³/h. LZ-60 prints 5500 kg. Diesel 60 prints 35 m³/h. Diesel 60 does not print those cells. Electric 60 does not print HBT60-13.132. Do not treat 145 as a correction of 144. LZ-60’s list used here has no hopper volume. The string HBT60-13.132 is not a single purchase at Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai. If your order must name 100 / 125 mm pipe and aggregate 4 cm and below, that pair is on the LZ-60 sheet. 144 kW and 145 kW are printed on different pages, with different output, pressure, distance labels and weight. LZ-60 prints 6105 / 145 kW, 50 m³/h, 35 MPa, conveying 100 m, height 300 m, aggregate 4 cm and below, pipe 100 / 125 mm, 6.6 × 1.8 × 1.9 m and 5500 kg. “HBT60-13.132, page /en/products/lz-60-diesel-concrete-pump/, diesel, stone size, distances.” Hebei Pinjin Machinery confirms the price for that page only. Diesel 60 prints 6105 / 144 kW, 35 m³/h, 30 MPa, hopper 0.4 m³, 150 m / 350 m, Kawasaki double pump 100, 4800 × 1700 × 1700 mm and 3500 kg, and it does not print aggregate. The section title “Belt Length” comes from the source page and does not add a rating.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台印出的是HBT60-13.132 在邢台同时标着柴油60和 LZ-60的数字。要打开的行是 /products/diesel-60-concrete-pump。柴油60不印这些格子。柴油60印 35 m³/h。LZ-60 印 50 m³/h。LZ-60 印 5500 kg。不要把 145 当成 144 的更正。电动60不印 HBT60-13.132。此处使用的 LZ-60 列表没有料斗容积。字符串 HBT60-13.132 在河北品锦机械（邢台）不是一笔采购。144 kW 和 145 kW 印在不同页面，输送量、压力、距离标题和重量都不同。如果订单必须写管径 100 / 125 mm 和骨料 4 cm 及以下，这一对在 LZ-60 的表上。“HBT60-13.132，页面 /zh/products/lz-60-diesel-concrete-pump/，柴油，石子粒径，距离。柴油60印 6105 / 144 kW、35 m³/h、30 MPa、料斗 0.4 m³、150 m / 350 m、川崎双泵 100、4800 × 1700 × 1700 mm、3500 kg，并且不印骨料。LZ-60 印 6105 / 145 kW、50 m³/h、35 MPa、输送距离 100 m、高度 300 m、骨料 4 cm 及以下、管径 100 / 125 mm、6.6 × 1.8 × 1.9 m、5500 kg。节标题「皮带 长度」来自来源页，不另加额定值。

body.en: “Belt Length” titles this part of the Diesel 60 Concrete Pump note. The figures stay the printed ones. LZ-60 prints 50 m³/h. Electric 60 does not print HBT60-13.132. If your order must name 100 / 125 mm pipe and aggregate 4 cm and below, that pair is on the LZ-60 sheet. Diesel 60 prints 6105 / 144 kW, 35 m³/h, 30 MPa, hopper 0.4 m³, 150 m / 350 m, Kawasaki double pump 100, 4800 × 1700 × 1700 mm and 3500 kg, and it does not print aggregate.
body.zh: 「皮带 长度」是HBT60-13.132 在邢台同时标着柴油60和 LZ-60这一节的标题。数字仍以已印的为准。LZ-60 印 50 m³/h。“HBT60-13.132，页面 /zh/products/lz-60-diesel-concrete-pump/，柴油，石子粒径，距离。LZ-60 印 6105 / 145 kW、50 m³/h、35 MPa、输送距离 100 m、高度 300 m、骨料 4 cm 及以下、管径 100 / 125 mm、6.6 × 1.8 × 1.9 m、5500 kg。柴油60印 6105 / 144 kW、35 m³/h、30 MPa、料斗 0.4 m³、150 m / 350 m、川崎双泵 100、4800 × 1700 × 1700 mm、3500 kg，并且不印骨料。

body.en: For Diesel 60 Concrete Pump, the heading “Belt Velocity” does not replace a cell. LZ-60 prints 5500 kg. Do not treat 145 as a correction of 144. 144 kW and 145 kW are printed on different pages, with different output, pressure, distance labels and weight.
body.zh: 对HBT60-13.132 在邢台同时标着柴油60和 LZ-60而言，标题「皮带 速度」并不替换任何格子。LZ-60 印 5500 kg。不要把 145 当成 144 的更正。144 kW 和 145 kW 印在不同页面，输送量、压力、距离标题和重量都不同。

body.en: Diesel 60 Concrete Pump is unchanged by the heading “Horsepower”. Diesel 60 prints 35 m³/h. LZ-60’s list used here has no hopper volume. LZ-60 prints 6105 / 145 kW, 50 m³/h, 35 MPa, conveying 100 m, height 300 m, aggregate 4 cm and below, pipe 100 / 125 mm, 6.6 × 1.8 × 1.9 m and 5500 kg.
body.zh: HBT60-13.132 在邢台同时标着柴油60和 LZ-60不因标题「马力」而改动。柴油60印 35 m³/h。柴油60不印这些格子。如果订单必须写管径 100 / 125 mm 和骨料 4 cm 及以下，这一对在 LZ-60 的表上。

body.en: This section is titled “Speed Ratio”. Diesel 60 Concrete Pump still prints the cells below. Diesel 60 does not print those cells. The string HBT60-13.132 is not a single purchase at Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai. “HBT60-13.132, page /en/products/lz-60-diesel-concrete-pump/, diesel, stone size, distances.” Hebei Pinjin Machinery confirms the price for that page only. The photograph is an image from the source page https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/length-belt-fans-motors-d_872.html.
body.zh: 本节标题是「转速 比」。HBT60-13.132 在邢台同时标着柴油60和 LZ-60下面这些格子仍是印出来的。电动60不印 HBT60-13.132。字符串 HBT60-13.132 在河北品锦机械（邢台）不是一笔采购。此处使用的 LZ-60 列表没有料斗容积。配图来自来源页 https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/length-belt-fans-motors-d_872.html。

question.en: Does “Belt Length” replace LZ-60 prints 50 m³/h?
question.zh: 「皮带 长度」会替换「柴油60不印这些格子。」吗？

answer.en: No. LZ-60 prints 50 m³/h remains the printed wording for Diesel 60 Concrete Pump.
answer.zh: 不会。柴油60不印这些格子。仍是HBT60-13.132 在邢台同时标着柴油60和 LZ-60已印的说法。

question.en: Where does LZ-60 prints 5500 kg belong on the Diesel 60 Concrete Pump row?
question.zh: HBT60-13.132 在邢台同时标着柴油60和 LZ-60这一行里，「柴油60印 35 m³/h。」放在哪里？

answer.en: It belongs on /products/diesel-60-concrete-pump, beside the other printed cells, not under a guessed heading.
answer.zh: 它属于 /products/diesel-60-concrete-pump，和其他已印格子在一起，不放到猜出来的标题下面。

question.en: What does “Belt Velocity” add to Diesel 60 Concrete Pump?
question.zh: 「皮带 速度」给HBT60-13.132 在邢台同时标着柴油60和 LZ-60增加了什么？

answer.en: It is only the section title taken from https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/length-belt-fans-motors-d_872.html. It does not add a performance figure.
answer.zh: 它只是取自 https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/length-belt-fans-motors-d_872.html 的节标题，不增加性能数字。

question.en: Which path names the Diesel 60 Concrete Pump row?
question.zh: 哪条路径对应HBT60-13.132 在邢台同时标着柴油60和 LZ-60这一行？
